name: page-guide-alias-precedence
goal: Preserve canonical topic and plural precedence when adding page help aliases; guard the shared topic resolver through its standardized lookup matrix

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Unreleased alias change 242d0cec sends plural pages directly to view even when a canonical page topic exists; the previous generic plural resolver preferred the canonical topic.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standard guide lookup scenario checked aliases only against the built-in catalog. Extend its reusable matrix with canonical/alias collisions, plural forms and case normalization.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint 9284d7f7 on e510943a reproduces the canonical-topic collision in the standard guide lookup matrix.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Keep canonical candidates before the view fallback; require collision and normalization coverage before extending an alias resolver.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Preserve page before view and add the reusable alias review gate to repository agent instructions; keep the standard lookup test unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint 22d74c09 at ce231cafa passes the same frozen guide test and retains fresh behavior timing and worker memory.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: After repair, independent clean-snapshot capture 92a2340e reruns e510943a and fails the unchanged guard; restored ce231cafa passes in 22d74c09.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
